implementation_integrity: Pass: coherent incumbent identity and shared interaction code; technical defects remain.

issues.title: Narrow layouts and enlarged text overflow
issues.evidence: 24 of 96 production pages exceed the 320px viewport (322–607px). Raw reference URLs extend to 544px in the Django PowerShell guide. Presentation prose and resource tables extend outside their containers. A 200% root-font probe also overflows the homepage, docs landing page and presentation.
issues.impact: Readers on narrow screens or using enlarged text can lose content or must pan the whole page.
issues.standard: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow for non-exempt prose; enlarged-text probe is diagnostic, not a complete browser-zoom conformance test.
issues.recommendation: Wrap raw URLs; use minmax(0, 1fr) and min-width: 0 for grids; constrain tables and equations to local scroll containers; let grids collapse with content size.

issues.title: Nested checklist links cannot be activated with Enter
issues.evidence: Focusing the Excalidraw link and pressing Enter changes its parent checkbox from false to true; no destination opens. The parent keydown handler prevents the link default action.
issues.impact: Keyboard users cannot follow this assessment resource link.
issues.standard: WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard; invalid nested interactive control structure.
issues.recommendation: Use a native checkbox and separate label; keep links outside the checkbox control; scope keyboard handlers to the intended control.

issues.title: Assessment progress bars have no accessible names
issues.evidence: Seven role=progressbar controls have values but no aria-label or aria-labelledby.
issues.impact: Assistive technology receives a progress value without a programmatic description of what it measures.
issues.recommendation: Connect each progress bar to its visible progress heading with aria-labelledby.

issues.title: Inline assessment links rely on color alone
issues.evidence: Excalidraw and Draw.io links have no persistent underline and only 1.04:1 contrast against surrounding text.
issues.impact: Readers may not recognize these words as links.
issues.recommendation: Underline inline prose links in their resting state.

issues.title: Presentation eagerly loads approximately 31 MB of images
issues.evidence: 18 active local image references total 30,952,859 bytes; all omit lazy loading. The geometry schematic alone is 11,877,001 bytes.
issues.impact: Large initial transfer and image decoding penalize mobile connections and devices.
issues.recommendation: Create appropriately sized WebP/AVIF variants, preserve scientific detail, supply dimensions, and lazy-load figures below the first slide. Ensure PDF export awaits deferred images.

issues.title: Several standalone link targets remain below 44px
issues.evidence: Guide-card links measure approximately 34.5px high; the homepage featured-guide link is approximately 23.4px high.
issues.impact: Smaller targets make touch selection less forgiving.
issues.standard: Impeccable 44px touch-target criterion; not treated as an automatic WCAG AA failure.
issues.recommendation: Increase the clickable area of standalone card and action links to at least 44px without changing prose-link layout.

detector.interpretation: Repeated aesthetic flags and static cascade/background inference are not counted as distinct defects.
detector.false_positive_verified: Axe scrollable-region-focusable warnings: all inspected scroll containers accept native Chromium focus. The SYSTEMCTL pre block is reachable by Tab and ArrowRight scrolls it 40px.

positive_findings: Existing 10 interaction checks passed in the preceding verification; source was unchanged during this audit.
Sampled rendered pages had no axe text/background contrast violations.
Homepage image variants total 528,868 bytes versus 3,759,069 bytes of originals, with explicit dimensions and 8 of 9 images lazy-loaded.
Shared menu focus containment, Escape handling, keyboard disclosures, guide-filter status, reduced-motion behavior and no-JavaScript reading fallbacks are present.
Prior static checks cover landmarks, heading order, image alt attributes and local links across production pages.
limitations: Physical iOS/Android devices and screen readers were not exercised.
No production Core Web Vitals or throttled-network timings were measured.
Tables and equations can require two-dimensional scrolling; root overflow measurements alone are not a conformance verdict.
